new_result.name: exact two-sheet hyperbolic-trace normal form for rank-three indefinite targets
new_result.statement: For A=R diag(lambda1,lambda2,-mu) R^T and the product-provenance spectral density rho of Z=diag(sqrt(lambda1),sqrt(lambda2),sqrt(mu))R^T X, the minority density is H_rho(alpha)=(1/2)sum_{sigma=+/-1} int_0^{2pi} int_{sqrt(alpha)}^infinity rho(sqrt(w^2-alpha)cos(theta),sqrt(w^2-alpha)sin(theta),sigma w) dw dtheta. The formula follows from a full-dimensional change of variables with Jacobian 1/2 and is valid for rough inputs. If s=min(lambda1,lambda2,mu) and M_-=s esssup H_rho, then M_- <= s||p_Q||_infinity <= max{pi sqrt(2),M_-} by the completed account02/B15 one-sheet theorem. Hence finiteness of the exact-rank-three indefinite universal constant is equivalent to a universal product-provenance bound on this hyperbolic-ray trace.
new_result.regularity_application: Using account02/B15 fixed-target C0 regularity, p_Q(t)<=pi sqrt(2)/s pointwise on the whole majority half-line including the critical value; any attained maximum above that threshold lies strictly on the minority/two-sheet side.

unresolved_implication: Prove a universal bound s esssup_{alpha>0} H_rho(alpha)<=M for product-provenance spectral densities; generic X-ray caps are insufficient by the live two-sheet correction.
